posts.author: GoldExperienceR
posts.body: Hi, I'm trying to create a monster arena in RPG Maker MZ. I want it to be something like you can either go in as a team, or as an individual, and can only go in about 3-5 times then it closes (either for good or for a while. I'd prefer "for a while", but if permanently is easier we'll go with that). I'm not CERTAIN you'll need my plug ins, but I'm placing it in just in case. I appreciate the help in advance.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Are you expecting people to just write a whole a** tutorial for you? Based on your description, all this can be done with basic event commands, and not even very complex.
Utilize a variable to count the amount of times the player has entered "it". Make event page in transfer event with the condition of said variable value you want the max to be to disable it. Reset variable to 0 with whatever time or otherwise condition you want via a common event.
Make events that add/remove characters to your party.
That's about it, based on what you've described.

posts.author: LowrellLovelace
posts.body:
Put a control variables event command after every battle that increases the numOfBattles variable by a constant value "1". Then in the conditions on the left you want to check variables and set it to the variable and value you want it to show at. The game logic always shows the highest page event that fulfills the conditions.
I would suggest to go to the help tab and check out the tutorial. You seem awfully new at RMMZ and it's quicker than waiting several hours for reply for something as basic as this.
